summary: This directory facilitates the automated generation and context initialization of README documentation for the package, ensuring that project documentation remains consistent and reflective of the codebase structure through automated testing of documentation utilities.
responsibilities: Initialize the context required for documentation creation
Verify documentation generation logic via unit tests
relationships: The build context provides the necessary data and configuration to drive the automated generation of documentation files.
The generation process relies on the initialized context to structure the output of documentation content.
designDecisions: Colocation of testing logic with documentation utility code
Use of specialized build contexts to isolate documentation configuration
